{{Quote|You again?  I think I'm done with you. I'm going to have you arrested.''"<br />"''Certainly. And when you do, this journal of yours will go with me.''"<br />"''I beg your pardon?''"<br />"''Imperial Security will be happy to find a traitor that deals with Rebel sympathizers.|[[Imperial officer/Legends|Officer]] [[M'Kae/Legends|M'Kae]] and a Rebel spacer|<ref name="SWG:FtA">{{SWGcite|exp=RotW|type=other|Quest: "For the Alliance!"}}</ref>}}
During his service in on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo's]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Rori/Legends|Rori]], the [[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officer]] [[M'Kae/Legends|M'Kae]] kept a '''journal'''. Sometime after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], an agent of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] working for [[Wolff Kalos]] attacked an [[Imperial Base (Rori)|Imperial Base]] on Rori in order to steal M'Kae's journal and find sensitive information about a wanted [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] by the name [[Cal Handro]].<ref name="SWG:FtA" />

==Behind the scenes==
M'Kae's journal appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:FtA" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> M'Kae's journal appeared during the fourth chapter of the "[[W:c:swg:Secrets of the Syren|Secrets of the Syren]]" questline,<ref name="SWG:FtA" /> released with the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 21 Notes for 4 August 2005|Publish 21]]," on [[August 4]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref> The "Secrets of the Syren" story arc was removed from the game with the "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 1|Chapter 1]]," published on [[June 8]], [[2006]], due to the major changes planed for Rori with the introduction of the [[Battle of Restuss]].<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter Archive 2006">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64186&resource=publish|text=Chapter Archive 2006}}</ref>
